name: Deploy Production Workflow
on: workflow_run: workflows: - Publish Images to DockerHub types: - completed workflow_dispatch: inputs: image_tag: description: "Image tag to deploy (for example: v1.2.3)" required: true type: string
permissions: contents: read
jobs: deploy: if: "github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success')" runs-on: ubuntu-latest timeout-minutes: 30 environment: name: Production env: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }} DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD }} steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }} - name: Resolve image tag id: tag shell: bash run: | if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then echo "value=${{ inputs.image_tag }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" exit 0 fi
git fetch --force --tags TAG="$(git tag --points-at HEAD | head -n1)"
if [[ -z "$TAG" ]]; then echo "No git tag found for this commit. Skipping deployment." echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" else echo "value=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" fi - name: Skip when commit is not tagged if: steps.tag.outputs.skip == 'true' run: 'echo "Skipped: No tag found for this commit."' - name: Docker login if: steps.tag.outputs.skip != 'true' run: | echo "${DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD}" | docker login -u "${DOCKERHUB_USERNAME}" --password-stdin - name: Set image tag if: steps.tag.outputs.skip != 'true' run: echo "IMAGE_TAG=${{ steps.tag.outputs.value }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV - name: Run docker compose (test deploy) if: steps.tag.outputs.skip != 'true' run: | docker compose pull || true docker compose up -d --build - name: Verify containers if: steps.tag.outputs.skip != 'true' run: docker ps
